Questions

Frequently asked questions

What payment methods does Evoxt accept?

Evoxt accepts credit cards, debit cards, PayPal, Bitcoin, and USDt Tron.

What plan should I choose?

Start with the smallest plan if you are unsure. You can scale up later when your workload grows.

Can I prepay for the VM?

Yes. Evoxt offers billing plans from monthly up to 3 years. You can also top up Evoxt account credits and let the system apply credits to future invoices.

CPU clock speed vs Number of CPU cores?
